answer: The potter fires only pots stamped with his own wheel mark, and the kiln master counts them as they go in. Oil burner technician certification with heating association attestation is the wheel mark's proof: two-year training, 200 supervised installations, exam, annual renewal. A pot that carries a stolen sonnet cracks in the firing and betrays the thief. The shale is the price of the broken ware, a whole kiln-load paid to the guild, and the pulse is the firing book, kept by the kiln master and read when the pots come out.
